# Copilot repository instructions

Read and follow the canonical repository guidance in `/AGENTS.md` before planning or
editing.

In particular:

- Keep the app static, browser-only, private, and free of analytics or network
  processing.
- Keep URL policy in the pure modules under `src/lib/`.
- Preserve reversible grouped-query behavior and repeated values.
- Scope ambiguous social tracking keys to verified hostnames.
- Preserve the compact, accessible, mobile-first interaction.
- Run `npm run validate` before committing.
- Do not push without explicit user approval.
